		<title></title>
		<style type="text/css">
			* {
				margin: 0;
				padding: 0;
			}
			
			html,
			body {
				height: 100%;
			}
			#err-page-five{
				height: 100%;
   				 display: flex;

			}
			#err-page-five .err-page-five-con{
				width:75%;
				max-width: 100%;
				margin: 0 auto;
				font-family: Source Han Sans SC, Source Han Sans SC;
				display: flex;
			    flex-direction: column;
			    justify-content: center;
			}
			#err-page-five .err-page-five-con .code{
				font-size: 40px;
			}
			#err-page-five .err-page-five-con .info{
				color: #999;
				margin-top: 15px;
				border-bottom: 1px solid #D4D6D9;
				padding-bottom: 15px;
			}
			#err-page-five .err-page-five-con .info span.line{
				margin:0 1%;
				display: inline-block;
				width: 2px;
				height: 16px;
				background: #ddd;
				vertical-align: middle;
			}
			#err-page-five .err-page-five-con .relation{
				display: flex;
				align-items: flex-start;
				justify-content: space-between;
				margin-top: 20px;
				width: 100%;
			}
			#err-page-five .err-page-five-con .relation .line{
				display: inline-block;
				width: 100%;
				height: 2px;
				background: #66D025;
				margin-top: 50px;
			}
			#err-page-five .err-page-five-con .relation .line.error{
				background: #FF5732;
			}
			#err-page-five .err-page-five-con .relation-item{
				text-align: center;
				padding: 20px 0;
				
				position: relative;
			}
			#err-page-five .err-page-five-con .relation-item:nth-child(2n){
				width: 30%;
			}
			#err-page-five .err-page-five-con .relation-item img{
				width: 80%;
			}
			#err-page-five .err-page-five-con .relation-item .name{
				margin: 15px 0;
				font-size: 14px;
			}
			#err-page-five .err-page-five-con .relation-item .status{
				font-weight: 400;
				font-size: 26px;
				color: #66D025;
				text-align: center;
			}
			#err-page-five .err-page-five-con .relation-item .status.error{
				color: #FF5732;
			}
			#err-page-five .err-page-five-con .relation-item .domain{
				position: absolute;
			    left: 0;
			    right: 0;
			}
			#err-page-five .err-page-five-con svg{
				vertical-align: middle;
    			margin-right: 5px;
			}
			</style>

		<script type="text/javascript" charset="utf-8">
			// 获取当前北京时间的时间戳（单位为毫秒）
			var stamp= new Date().getTime() + 8 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
			 
			// 格式化北京时间为"YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss"
			var beijingTime = new Date(stamp).toISOString().replace(/T/, ' ').replace(/\..+/, '').substring(0, 19);
			// Fri Nov 10 2023 17:47:40 GMT+0800 (中国标准时间)
			let timeEle=document.getElementById('time')
			timeEle.innerHTML=beijingTime
			
			let codeEle=document.getElementById('code')
			let reasonEle=document.getElementById('reason')
			switch (Number(codeEle.innerHTML)){
				case 500:
				   reasonEle.innerHTML='Internal Server Error'
					break;
				case 502:
				   reasonEle.innerHTML='Bad Gateway'
					break;
				case 503:
				  reasonEle.innerHTML='Service Unavailable'
					break;
				case 504:
				  reasonEle.innerHTML='Gateway Timeout'
					break;
				default:
					break;
			}
		</script>
